name: Kaziranga National Park
description: Kaziranga sits on the southern bank of the Brahmaputra River in Assam, northeast India, where tall elephant grass, wetlands and dense forest stretch across the floodplain. It shelters the world's largest population of one-horned rhinoceroses, which you can often spot from a jeep or elephant-back safari. Tigers, wild water buffalo, elephants and swamp deer share the park with thousands of birds.
